_frame_plan_note: Six shots on the proven 32.0s/960-frame shape (shared loudness QA assumes six 5s windows). Each shot's narration_en is the sentence spoken over it; must_show_while_spoken lists the physical conditions that have to be true in the simulated state AND visible in the picture for at least min_seconds while that sentence is spoken. Cutaway devices (half-cut barrel, translucent shells, orange/green reference planes) are labelled in visual_proof.

shots.visual_proof: Slow motion at one tenth speed, from beside and just ahead of the car: the nose reaches the first barrel, it bursts, sand and shell chips fly forward, the car pitches nose-down and slows; cut to a raised view from behind as the cascade continues down the array.
shots.narration_en: This car hits a wall of plastic barrels at highway speed, and every single one bursts into flying sand.

shots.visual_proof: One real barrel drawn cut in half (cutaway device): the thin shell wall and the sand packed inside, seen in an orbit and then close on the cut face.
shots.narration_en: Each barrel is nothing but a thin plastic shell packed full of sand.

shots.visual_proof: Twentieth-speed macro at the nose: the sand ahead of the bumper is thrown forward at about the car's own speed while the car slows and pitches nose-down.
shots.narration_en: Each pile of sand it hits must be sped up, and that speed comes out of the car.

shots.visual_proof: Barrel shells drawn translucent (cutaway device) so the sand level in every barrel shows: few kilograms in front, much more toward the back, while the car works through the array and slows.
shots.narration_en: The barrels toward the back hold more sand, so the car slows lightly at first and harder deeper in.

shots.visual_proof: Straight-down view with metre ticks. First the same car, same speed, stopping within the distance a rigid wall allows (orange line); then the barrel array, where the car passes that orange line still rolling and only stops at the green line about six metres in.
shots.narration_en: A concrete wall would stop it in about one meter; these barrels stretch that to six.

shots.visual_proof: Raised aerial of an intact array standing in front of a hard concrete barrier end with hazard stripes, while a car passes safely in the next lane.
shots.narration_en: That is why barrels like these guard busy highway exits and the hard concrete ends of barriers.

first_three_seconds.note: Counts physical events becoming true and visible, not cuts or camera moves.
